policy: Capability additions, deprecations, removals, reactivations, and capability_contract_version changes require an explicit entry tied to the resulting registry_version. Repository SHA remains the implementation identity; ordinary implementation changes that preserve the public capability contract do not require a capability-contract version bump.

entries.notes: Adds generic lifecycle verification for consequential bounded evidence-producing runs. The capability grants no authority, executes no project runner, and requires explicit consumer-side adoption.
Adds a new bounded local CSV aggregate adapter. Existing capability IDs and contracts are unchanged; consumers must explicitly opt in and provide local file/process authority.
